planting.note: Plant rooted cuttings in spring in full sun with excellent drainage; Sensational! grows unusually large for a lavandin and should be given extra spacing to show off its full mounded habit and long flower spikes.

directions: Plant in full sun with sharp drainage, amending heavy soil with coarse sand or gravel; Sensational! is a robust lavandin hybrid bred for exceptionally large size, with vigorous silvery foliage and some of the longest, most strongly fragrant flower spikes available in a garden lavender, held well above the foliage on tall, sturdy stems. Its bigger stature and heavier bloom make it a strong choice as a specimen plant, low hedge, or cut-flower and dried-lavender crop where scale and bloom quantity matter. Like other lavandins it is more tolerant of humidity than pure English lavender, though good air circulation and lean, fast-draining soil remain essential to prevent crown rot. Shear lightly after the main bloom flush to maintain a tidy mound and encourage a second, lighter bloom later in the season.

planting.note: Plant rooted cuttings in spring or fall in full sun with excellent drainage; Fred Boutin forms a large, dense, rounded mound and is often grown as an informal low hedge or border edge in California and Southern gardens.

directions: Plant in full sun with sharp drainage, in lean soil amended with coarse grit if the site tends to hold moisture; Fred Boutin is a lavandin hybrid, originally selected in California, prized for its exceptionally broad, dense, silvery-gray foliage mound and reliable production of long, richly fragrant purple-blue flower spikes in early summer. It is one of the more heat- and humidity-tolerant lavandins, making it a workable choice for Gulf South gardeners who have struggled with English lavender, and its large, uniform habit suits mass plantings and low hedges as well as single specimens. Shear the plant back by about a third right after flowering to keep growth compact and prevent the woody, sparse center that develops in unpruned lavenders over time.
